title: steadyHeat
body:
## steadyHeat

Predict steady solid wall temperature, heater rise and heat loss through ordered material layers with fixed temperature, outward flux or convection films.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Linear nodal finite elements are checked against exact layered conduction and source-corrected conservation.
- Heat flux is outward at boundaries and along +x in the derived element table; temperatures use kelvin.
- One-dimensional constant-property solid model only; independent saved-result reopening is mandatory.

Native binding: `Elmer HeatSolve HeatSolver`. Output kind: `["table","text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layers` | Order one to sixteen solid materials from left x=0 to the right. Each layer shares interface temperature and physical heat flux with its neighbour under perfect contact. At most 512 total cells; no contact resistance or imported geometry. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":16,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":48,"required":true},"thickness_m":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-05,"maximum":1000.0,"required":true},"conductivity_W_mK":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-05,"maximum":100000000.0,"required":true},"heatGeneration_W_m3":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000000.0,"maximum":100000000.0,"default":0},"cells":{"type":"integer","minimum":2,"maximum":128,"default":16}}}}` | **required** |
| `left` | Required left surface condition. Choose a fixed kelvin temperature, outward W/m2 flux, or convection film. At least one end must fix temperature or connect to an ambient film; two flux ends leave an undefined temperature offset. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"kind":{"type":"enum","values":["value","flux","convection"],"required":true},"value":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000000.0,"maximum":100000000.0},"coefficient":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-06,"maximum":100000000.0},"ambient":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000000.0,"maximum":100000000.0}}}` | **required** |
| `right` | Required right surface condition. Choose a fixed kelvin temperature, outward W/m2 flux, or convection film. At least one end must fix temperature or connect to an ambient film; two flux ends leave an undefined temperature offset. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"kind":{"type":"enum","values":["value","flux","convection"],"required":true},"value":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000000.0,"maximum":100000000.0},"coefficient":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-06,"maximum":100000000.0},"ambient":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000000.0,"maximum":100000000.0}}}` | **required** |
| `area_m2` | Constant solid cross-sectional area in square metres; omission gives one m2. It converts heat flux and volume generation to total watts. Under constant area it does not change the one-dimensional temperature field; do not use it to represent a tapered solid. | `{"type":"number","minimum":1e-08,"maximum":1000000.0}` | `1` |
| `limits` | Optional sampled design criteria. Omission or an empty object imposes no design limit. Bounds are applied literally to native mesh-node temperatures and derived element-midpoint flux, with signed margins retained; they do not certify unsampled continuum extrema. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"minimumField":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000000.0,"maximum":100000000.0},"maximumField":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000000.0,"maximum":100000000.0},"maxAbsFlux":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1000000000000.0}}}` | `{}` |
